texts.zh:
[Species.GetAdj]民众正在逐渐接受一个可以用强化体以全新的方式表达自我的世界。

但这种宽容只是表象，植入体的内增强监控算法现在正在监视着每一个人，在大脑突触连接的那一刻就能发现不当的想法。
texts.en:
The [Species.GetAdj] people are embracing a world where the augmented can express their identity in brand new ways.

But the leniency is only a facade, as enhanced surveillance algorithms within the implant are now monitoring every individual, detecting dissident thoughts the moment brain synapses connect.

texts.zh:
危难当前，唯有团结。每一个通过义体增强的[Species.GetAdj]都在为更美好的未来而奋斗，并相信身边的人也都会这样做。

具有钢铁般意志和光辉人格的[Ruler.GetName][Ruler.GetTitle]会带领我们的人民向前进，他们大可对此放心。
texts.en:
There is strength in numbers and its unifying momentum in the face of adversity. Every cyber-enhanced [Species.GetAdj] fights towards a better future together, trusting the person next to them to do the same.

Our people can rest secure in the knowledge that the radiant personality of their iron-willed [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetName] guides them onwards.

texts.zh:
当人民继续在十字路口犹豫不决时时，我们的[Ruler.GetName][Ruler.GetTitle]必须抓住强化改造所提供的这一独特机会并作出决定。

应该让我们的人民保持一定的自由意志，以植入体进行监控，或是要让他们完全由领袖光芒四射的意志所引领。
texts.en:
As the people continue to waver in the crossroads, our [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetName] must seize this unique opportunity offered by the augmentations and make a decision.

Should our people be allowed some personal freedoms while monitoring them through their implants, or have them influenced by the will of their leader's radiant personality?

label.zh: 给他们监视下的适度自由。

# 人群控制 / Crowd Controlled

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：events/machine_age_situation_events_1.txt:5761-5931

## 如何开始 How it starts

- “未来冲击”事件链的终点：休闲/社会事件结束后180+随机90天，隐藏事件 cyber.1500 按政体权威（switch has_authority）分发：民主 1505、寡头 1510、独裁 1515、帝制 1520、企业 1525。
  End of the "Future Shock" chain: 180 days (+ random 90) after the leisure/society event hidden cyber.1500 switches on has_authority: democratic 1505, oligarchic 1510, dictatorial 1515, imperial 1520, corporate 1525.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「独裁政体」的最终事件：国家选择个人主义（cyber_individualist）或集体主义（cyber_collectivist）的网络化取向，设置相应国家标志；独裁者按统治者类型（官员/指挥官/科学家/空缺）出现不同的集体主义选项；另有一个保留现状的选项。
  The final event for dictatorial governments: the country picks an individualist (cyber_individualist) or collectivist (cyber_collectivist) orientation of cyberization and the matching country flag is set; dictatorships get different collectivist options by ruler type (official / commander / scientist / vacant); a third option keeps the status quo.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 故事终点；五个政体版本互斥（由 has_authority 决定）。
  The end of the chain; the five authority versions are exclusive (by has_authority).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 仅出现给独裁权威的国家。
  Shown only to dictatorial (authority auth_dictatorial) countries.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 说明：这十个最终事件（cyber/synth 1505–1525）不在任何审阅者的分配列表中，作为连带内容一并审阅。
  Note: these ten final events (cyber/synth 1505-1525) are in no reviewer's assignment list and were reviewed as part of the same chains.
- 已核对：触发条件、选项效果；编译树与脚本一致。
  Checked: trigger conditions and option effects; the compiled tree matches the script.
